title: UKRI AI Centre for Doctoral Training in Decision Making for Complex Systems
institution: UKRI AI Centre for Doctoral Training in Decision Making for Complex Systems (University of Manchester)
field: Artificial intelligence, decision making for complex systems
about: Fully funded four-year PhD programme (taught first year, then a supervised research project) at the UKRI AI Centre for Doctoral Training in Decision Making for Complex Systems. New projects for September 2027 are available; the application deadline is 4 December 2026.
requirements: Upper second-class honours degree in a directly relevant discipline, or equivalent
Name the research project to be considered when applying
Applications are completed on the University of Manchester website

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: Requirement "Name the research project to be considered when applying" -> objective "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

Programme "taught first year, then a supervised research project" -> objective "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."
Doctoral research context -> objective "Apply responsible practices for verification, attribution, citation awareness, confidentiality, and academic integrity when using AI in research activities."
